ms.report:
Dear Reviewers,
Thank you for your detailed feedback. I appreciate the opportunity to clarify some points and provide additional evidence where needed.
Regarding the webinar, it did indeed take place last year. It was actually the first event we organized for Milestone 2, and I believe you may recall that there were some back-and-forth discussions regarding the proposal. A total of 12 people attended the session. The video uploaded to YouTube is the presentation segment, which later led to a Q&A session. The full event lasted around 45 minutes. I have uploaded screenshots of the webinar here:
Google Drive Link
For the Telegram poll, I would like to clarify that it was answered by 7 people, not just one. The screenshot provided includes the text "7 votos", which means 7 votes. You also have access to the Telegram group link if you’d like to verify this directly. All 7 respondents indicated that they were very satisfied with the content. Given that the milestone objective set a minimum attendance of 10 participants, having 7 confirm they are highly satisfied represents a 70% satisfaction rate, which we believe is strong evidence of positive engagement.
As for the engagement targets on X, I understand your concerns. While we have reached 113 followers on X, engagement is indeed a key factor. The account was created in January 2024, aligning with the launch of this proposal. We have compiled a folder with screenshots showing post views and organic account growth. These materials demonstrate that, beyond just follower count, the content is being viewed and engaged with:
https://drive.google.com/drive/u/3/folders/1ZG4t7JgeFQ6RSxQmLzKZIR72geEvjySn
I hope this clarifies the points raised. Please let me know if any additional information is required, and I’ll be happy to provide it.
Have a nice week
Best regards,
Martina
